rationale: All three items from round 1 are genuinely fixed in 0c0ee7ee (depth-1 heading, template heading moved below the artifact contracts with an ordering assertion, and the placement test added), but replacing the depth rule with a flat one re-opens a fail-open leak I verified against the compiled pin: a '### ' subheading inside Reuse and Scope ends the skip, so a backticked path under it enters approvedPaths (round 1 returned ['src/a.ts'], round 2 returns ['src/a.ts','src/b.ts']) — a two-line guard closes it while keeping the depth-1 fix, namely record the reuse heading's depth and continue skipping while 'depth > recorded && recorded > 1', which I prototyped green on all four shapes (reuse last, two aliases, depth-1 heading, nested subheading).
